headline: On October 14, 2012: Felix Baumgartner Jumps from Stratosphere
captionCards: Felix Baumgartner broke the sound barrier in freefall
His jump inspired new aerospace and extreme sports innovations
instagramCaption:
Felix Baumgartner made history with a daring jump. \\[Blank Line] On October 14, 2012, Austrian skydiver Felix Baumgartner jumped to Earth from a helium balloon in the stratosphere, landing in New Mexico, USA. He set world records for skydiving from an estimated 39 km (24 mi) and reaching a top speed of 1,357.64 km/h (843.6 mph), breaking the sound barrier without vehicular power. This jump was part of the Red Bull Stratos project. His feat still inspires extreme sports and aerospace innovation. \\[Blank Line] What do you think was the most challenging part of his jump? \\[Blank Line] Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
